features.description: Integration ActionItem catalog: declare the operator-owned integration steps (Firebase functions deploy, Firebase realtime smoke, static-dashboard smoke, Linear credential setup, Discord webhook setup) as ActionItems produced by a new provide_integration_actions() source in operator_console.py with its own SOURCE_INTEGRATION source kind, each carrying what/why/credentials_required/exact_command/evidence_expected/reversible plus the shipped control-plane spine fields (audience, dedupe_key, plain_consequence, clears_when, resolution_class). Data + projection, not credential handling.
steps: Enumerate the known operator integration steps + their exact commands
Model each as an ActionItem (audience=operator, requires_human where creds needed)
Mark credentials_required + reversible + evidence_expected per item
Fixture tests over the catalog projection
features.acceptance: provide_integration_actions() emits one ActionItem per integration step through the same source-provider seam as the five shipped providers in operator_console.py, with the new SOURCE_INTEGRATION source kind and what/why/credentials_required/exact_command/evidence_expected/reversible populated from the integration_catalog; spine fields are populated - resolution_class reflects credential need (RESOLUTION_OPERATOR_ATTESTED or RESOLUTION_BLOCKED_EXTERNAL for credentialed steps, never RESOLUTION_COMMAND_RESOLVABLE for them) and clears_when names the evidence that resolves the item; dedupe_key is stable across rebuilds; no secrets (webhook URLs/tokens) appear in any item field. Verified by fixture tests through the real provider seam.

features.description: Static-dashboard smoke action (applies today): a runnable check that `dontpanic state export-dashboard` produces a static dashboard that renders, capturing the run output as evidence. Re-homes the static half of firebase-adapter F005 as an operator action.
steps: Implement a static-smoke runner: export-dashboard → assert artifacts present + parseable
Capture run output as an evidence ref
Wire as the F001 'static-dashboard smoke' ActionItem's exact command
Test: smoke passes on a fixture state; fails loudly on missing/garbled state
features.acceptance: Running the static-dashboard smoke verifies export-dashboard artifacts render and records an evidence ref; it fails clearly on missing/garbled state; no Firebase credentials required.

features.description: Gated realtime/deploy actions: represent Firebase functions deploy + realtime smoke (code already shipped+tested in dashboard/functions/) as ActionItems gated on multi-operator need + credentials. Never auto-executes; surfaces the exact command + evidence the operator must capture. Re-homes firebase-adapter F003/F005 realtime half, parked behind its trigger.
steps: Model deploy + realtime-smoke as gated ActionItems (requires_human=true, credentials_required=true)
Encode the trigger condition (multi-operator dashboard needed) in the item's why/availability
Reference the shipped dashboard/functions/ + firestore.rules as prerequisites met
Test: items render as gated/unavailable until trigger + creds present; never execute in-repo
features.acceptance: Firebase deploy + realtime smoke appear as gated operator ActionItems carrying exact commands + required evidence, marked credentials_required and reversible-as-applicable with resolution_class RESOLUTION_OPERATOR_ATTESTED; they never execute in-repo and surface their trigger condition (multi-operator need) in the item text. Verified by fixture tests through the provider seam.

features.description: Integration status surfacing: per-integration status (configured / deployed / smoke-passing / pending) derived from the catalog + captured evidence and routed through the SHIPPED action surfaces (what-now-logic bands, render-gate, operator console action items) - no separate integrations panel; the new work is the status derivation feeding those surfaces, so the operator sees integration readiness at a glance rather than via command archaeology.
steps: Derive per-integration status from catalog + evidence refs
Pending items link to their F001 ActionItem
Test: status reflects presence/absence of evidence; no secret leak
features.acceptance: Each integration's derived status is truthful against catalog + evidence fixtures (configured/deployed/smoke-passing/pending each exercised); integration items render deduped through the existing what-now/operator-console surfaces with pending integrations linking to their ActionItem (dedupe_key stable across rebuilds); resolved integrations clear via their clears_when predicate rather than hand-editing; rendering leaks no secrets. Verified by tests through the real producer-to-render path per the operator-outcome QA sufficiency contract (fixtures enter the real shell surface, not pre-baked shapes).
